text.text_excerpt: Out of all the chinese places I have been to in New Orleans this one is one of the best! Most of the time when I go to take out chinese restaurants the food tastes kinda stale. Not here though I can tell that the food is fresh. It is also WAY better tasting food than most others. The people who run the place were pretty friendly. The prices were pretty cheap too. One of my favorite dishes here was General Tso's chicken. It was spicy and very good! The egg rolls were good and so was the shrimp fried rice. Ever since I first tried there food I have been back several times. I think my favorite thing though is the fact that this place is so close to where I live! In short this is a fantastic ...

My favorite go-to Chinese food spot! I live nearby so the location is great!! Food is fresh and hot. Very flavorful and tasty!! The service is good and they're open late too!! Always a plus for some late grub!! Try it out!!! Crab Rangoon, boneless chicken, egg rolls and shrimp and combination rice are some of my favs!! Fried wings are good too......only $4.75 for 4 while wings!! $5.99 with rice. Can't beat that!!

Best Chinese food in town!! Today me and my husband went for the first time and we both said "best chinese food ever". The place is very clean and well organized. The food OMG delicious and enough to eat and save some for later. I tried the vegetable soup and the cashew chicken with shrimp fried rice ans eggrolls. My husband got the shrimp general tso. The prices are reasonable too. We will definitely go back there every time we want chinese food!
